name: Fantasy Football Tarot
description: A humorous NFL-themed tarot deck for pre-game fantasy football readings.
usageNotes: Treat the reading as playful entertainment, not a serious prediction.
Use a manager's actual roster, opponent, matchup, injury news, and projections as variables.
The examples are archetypes; replace player mappings as rosters and teams change.

positions.name: Last Week
positions.question: What energy follows this manager into the weekend?

positions.name: This Matchup
positions.question: What force is shaping the game ahead?

positions.name: The Temptation
positions.question: Which player is luring the manager into a risky start?

positions.name: The Hidden Factor
positions.question: What information is missing from the matchup?

positions.name: The Verdict
positions.question: What happens if the manager trusts the cards?

readingRules.reversalGuidance: A reversed card does not always mean the opposite. Treat it as blocked, delayed, excessive, hidden, or misdirected energy.

verdicts.label: The matchup hangs in the balance
The waiver wire must be consulted

majorArcana.name: The Fool

upright.meaning: A bold beginning, optimism, and reckless confidence
upright.footballArchetype: A rookie, a YOLO lineup choice, or a manager who starts the hype train immediately

reversed.meaning: Naivety, poor preparation, and a spectacularly avoidable mistake
reversed.footballArchetype: Starting a player because of one highlight clip

fortuneHooks: You have mistaken confidence for evidence.
The Fool asks only one question: is he actually projected to score points?

majorArcana.name: The Magician

upright.meaning: Skill, resourcefulness, and turning opportunity into results
upright.footballArchetype: The waiver-wire wizard or manager who always finds the breakout player

reversed.meaning: Manipulation, empty hype, or mistaking cleverness for production
reversed.footballArchetype: The manager who explains a terrible trade with a twelve-slide presentation

fortuneHooks: The Magician has all four tools: targets, touches, matchup, and an unreasonable amount of confidence.
A miracle is being attempted in the flex spot.

majorArcana.name: The High Priestess

upright.meaning: Intuition, hidden information, and secrets not yet revealed
upright.footballArchetype: The questionable tag, late inactive, or mysterious snap-count situation

reversed.meaning: Ignored warning signs, leaked secrets, and false confidence
reversed.footballArchetype: Seeing 'limited practice' and deciding it means 'fully healthy'

fortuneHooks: The injury report speaks in riddles, and the manager hears only what they want to hear.
At 11:58 a.m., the truth will be declared inactive.

majorArcana.name: The Empress

upright.meaning: Abundance, growth, comfort, and generous production
upright.footballArchetype: A bell-cow running back or offense that feeds its favorite weapon

reversed.meaning: Overindulgence, stagnation, or too much reliance on one source
reversed.footballArchetype: A running back with 25 touches and 2.1 yards per carry

fortuneHooks: The Empress promises volume, though not necessarily efficiency.
Many touches shall be bestowed. Whether they become points is between the line and the gods.

majorArcana.name: The Emperor

upright.meaning: Authority, structure, control, and stubborn leadership
upright.footballArchetype: A coach who refuses to abandon the game plan or a manager who never changes their draft strategy

reversed.meaning: Rigidity, tyranny, and control collapsing into chaos
reversed.footballArchetype: Refusing to bench a struggling star because of draft capital

fortuneHooks: The Emperor has made a decision. The decision is bad, but it is final.
No matchup data can move the hand that spent the second-round pick.

majorArcana.name: The Hierophant

upright.meaning: Tradition, rules, institutions, and conventional wisdom
upright.footballArchetype: The commissioner, the rulebook, or the manager who always follows consensus rankings

reversed.meaning: Rebellion, breaking convention, and challenging accepted wisdom
reversed.footballArchetype: Starting the backup against expert consensus

fortuneHooks: The sacred rankings have been consulted. The manager has ignored them.
A waiver claim made outside the approved traditions approaches.

majorArcana.name: The Lovers

upright.meaning: Connection, harmony, alignment, and meaningful partnership
upright.footballArchetype: A quarterback-wide receiver stack or a red-zone duo with perfect chemistry

reversed.meaning: Disconnection, bad chemistry, and a relationship under strain
reversed.footballArchetype: A target monster whose quarterback suddenly prefers everyone else

fortuneHooks: Two players become one fantasy transaction.
The stack is beautiful, unless the offense forgets how passing works.

majorArcana.name: The Chariot

upright.meaning: Momentum, determination, victory, and controlled force
upright.footballArchetype: A breakaway runner or quarterback who takes over the game

reversed.meaning: Loss of control, stalled momentum, and a crash
reversed.footballArchetype: A boom-or-bust player trapped behind a bad offensive line

fortuneHooks: The Chariot does not ask whether the lane is open. It creates a highlight and a questionable decision.
Momentum is yours until the fumble is reviewed.

majorArcana.name: Strength

upright.meaning: Courage, power, patience, and controlled aggression
upright.footballArchetype: A power back, dominant offensive line, or intimidating defender

reversed.meaning: Weakness exposed, frustration, or power used without control
reversed.footballArchetype: A feared defense that gives up a long touchdown immediately

fortuneHooks: The line bends. The line breaks. The projection remains strangely optimistic.
Strength arrives wearing shoulder pads and demanding a goal-line carry.

majorArcana.name: The Hermit

upright.meaning: Solitude, reflection, patience, and stepping away from the noise
upright.footballArchetype: An injured player on IR or a manager hiding from the group chat after a bad trade

reversed.meaning: Isolation, avoidance, and refusing useful advice
reversed.footballArchetype: Ignoring every trade offer while the roster quietly decays

fortuneHooks: The Hermit has left the lineup and will return when the fantasy season is over.
No messages can reach the manager in the recovery cave.

majorArcana.name: Wheel of Fortune

upright.meaning: Luck, cycles, timing, and forces outside your control
upright.footballArchetype: A matchup decided by a Monday night flex or an unpredictable touchdown

reversed.meaning: Bad timing, a cold streak, and luck that refuses to cooperate
reversed.footballArchetype: Leading all day until a backup tight end catches a late touchdown

fortuneHooks: The Wheel turns, and it has selected your opponent's fourth-string tight end.
Your process was sound. The universe remains unserious.

majorArcana.name: Justice

upright.meaning: Balance, accountability, truth, and consequences
upright.footballArchetype: A close scoring decision, a referee call, or the fantasy gods correcting an overconfident manager

reversed.meaning: Unfairness, bias, bad calls, and consequences that feel personal
reversed.footballArchetype: Losing by 0.04 points after a stat correction

fortuneHooks: The scales are balanced, but one side contains a stat correction.
Justice is blind. It has also apparently never watched this league.

majorArcana.name: The Hanged Man

upright.meaning: Pause, surrender, waiting, and seeing a situation differently
upright.footballArchetype: A bye-week player, committee back, or lineup decision delayed until Sunday morning

reversed.meaning: Stalling, wasted time, and refusing to accept reality
reversed.footballArchetype: Holding an injured player in the starting lineup until kickoff

fortuneHooks: The Hanged Man offers no points this week, but excellent perspective.
Your lineup is not undecided. It is suspended by hope.

majorArcana.name: Death

upright.meaning: Transformation, endings, release, and a new phase
upright.footballArchetype: A dominant defender, the end of an aging player's era, or a matchup that changes a season

reversed.meaning: Resistance to change, a delayed ending, or clinging to the past
reversed.footballArchetype: Keeping an aging star because of what they did three seasons ago

fortuneHooks: Death does not mean literal death. It means your opponent's quarterback will remember this matchup.
An era ends at the line of scrimmage, and your bench player inherits the kingdom.

majorArcana.name: Temperance

upright.meaning: Balance, moderation, patience, and combining forces
upright.footballArchetype: A balanced offense, reliable flex, or manager resisting a panicked trade

reversed.meaning: Imbalance, excess, and overcorrection
reversed.footballArchetype: Starting six players from one offense because the matchup looks good

fortuneHooks: Temperance advises a reasonable lineup, which is why the manager will not follow it.
The safest choice has arrived, wearing the least exciting jersey imaginable.

majorArcana.name: The Devil

upright.meaning: Temptation, attachment, excess, and seductive bargains
upright.footballArchetype: A risky trade, a revenge game narrative, or a player with irresistible upside

reversed.meaning: Breaking free, recognizing the trap, and escaping a bad deal
reversed.footballArchetype: Selling high before the regression arrives

fortuneHooks: The Devil offers you a trade. It includes upside, vibes, and no running-back depth.
You are not starting him because of the matchup. You are starting him because the narrative has you chained.

majorArcana.name: The Tower

upright.meaning: Sudden upheaval, collapse, shock, and truth arriving violently
upright.footballArchetype: A devastating injury, defensive collapse, missed field goal, or lineup disaster

reversed.meaning: Avoided disaster, delayed collapse, or damage already done
reversed.footballArchetype: Surviving a scare while your bench absorbs the real catastrophe

fortuneHooks: The Tower arrives before halftime and asks why you trusted that offensive line.
Disaster was avoided, technically. Your projected score is still embarrassing.

majorArcana.name: The Star

upright.meaning: Hope, healing, inspiration, and renewed confidence
upright.footballArchetype: A returning player, breakout candidate, or one bright spot on a bad roster

reversed.meaning: Disappointment, fading hope, and a dream losing its shine
reversed.footballArchetype: The breakout candidate who sees three targets

fortuneHooks: The Star promises a comeback, though perhaps only in the post-game interview.
Hope enters the lineup and immediately becomes questionable.

majorArcana.name: The Moon

upright.meaning: Uncertainty, illusion, anxiety, and hidden information
upright.footballArchetype: An overhyped sleeper, misleading matchup, or unclear backfield

reversed.meaning: Confusion clearing, a secret exposed, or the hype finally fading
reversed.footballArchetype: Realizing the waiver pickup was never going to play

fortuneHooks: The Moon makes every projection look plausible and none of them look trustworthy.
Beware the player whose best argument is that the matchup is interesting.

majorArcana.name: The Sun

upright.meaning: Joy, clarity, success, warmth, and unmistakable performance
upright.footballArchetype: A star player delivering exactly what the manager needed

reversed.meaning: A temporary setback, muted success, or joy arriving late
reversed.footballArchetype: A star who saves the week with a late touchdown after a quiet afternoon

fortuneHooks: The Sun rises over your roster, and at least one player remembers the end zone exists.
Clarity arrives: start the star, stop overthinking, accept the inevitable target share.

majorArcana.name: Judgement

upright.meaning: Reckoning, evaluation, revelation, and learning from the past
upright.footballArchetype: Trade deadline decisions, lineup accountability, or the consequences of draft day

reversed.meaning: Denial, refusing to learn, and repeating the same mistake
reversed.footballArchetype: Starting the same bust for the fourth straight week

fortuneHooks: The box score remembers everything.
Judgement asks why you benched the player who outscored your entire starting lineup.

majorArcana.name: The World

upright.meaning: Completion, mastery, celebration, and a full cycle fulfilled
upright.footballArchetype: A championship roster, perfect lineup, or manager finally escaping the consolation bracket

reversed.meaning: Incompleteness, unfinished business, and falling just short
reversed.footballArchetype: Losing the championship by one catch on Sunday night

fortuneHooks: The World is within reach, but your opponent still has one player on Monday night.
The cycle is complete: draft, panic, waiver claim, regret, and possibly glory.

suits.name: Wands
suits.footballTheme: Action, offense, speed, aggression, and explosive plays

suits.name: Cups
suits.footballTheme: Emotion, chemistry, rivalries, confidence, and locker-room energy

suits.name: Swords
suits.footballTheme: Conflict, strategy, pressure, injuries, and difficult decisions

suits.name: Pentacles
suits.footballTheme: Production, money, consistency, stats, and practical value

ranks.five: Conflict, scarcity, or a painful loss
ranks.seven: A test, challenge, or defense of a decision
ranks.page: A beginner, message, or intriguing prospect
ranks.knight: A player or manager charging into action

fortuneTemplates.text: {{manager}} enters the weekend beneath {{card1.name}} {{card1.orientation}}. {{card1.hook}} In the matchup, {{card2.name}} {{card2.orientation}} brings {{card2.archetype}} to {{opponent}}. But {{card3.name}} {{card3.orientation}} waits in the outlook: {{card3.hook}}. {{verdict}}
{{player}} appears under {{card.name}} {{card.orientation}}. The cards see {{card.archetype}}: {{playerStat}}. Start with courage, bench with wisdom, and blame the algorithm either way.

The cards warn {{manager}} not to confuse {{card.meaning}} with production. {{player}} has {{playerStat}}, a {{matchupDescription}} matchup, and exactly enough uncertainty to become your entire personality until kickoff.
{{verdict}} The projected score is merely a suggestion. The waiver wire is eternal.

openers: The cards have been shuffled, though your lineup has not.
The moon is high, the projections are questionable, and the group chat is watching.
Three cards are drawn. One of them is definitely judging your draft.
transitions: The energy shifts at the goal line.
This is where the matchup becomes personal.
The stars align, briefly, before the injury report updates.
closers: Trust the process, except for the parts you invented five minutes ago.
May your starters receive targets and your opponent's players discover defensive football.
The reading is complete. The overreaction begins Sunday at noon.

inputVariables.playerStat: Relevant projection, recent result, or matchup statistic
inputVariables.verdict: A generated win, toss-up, or loss verdict
inputVariables.card: A selected card object with orientation, meaning, archetype, hooks, and phrases
